item.text:
ResStock 2025 Release 1 assigns AMY weather **by county**:

- It uses a station within the county when one is available.
- Otherwise, it selects a station closest to the county’s **population centroid**, prioritizing stations in the same climate zone.
- Every modeled housing unit in that county uses the assigned weather file. Timestamps are shifted if the station is in a different time zone.

The documentation reports **approximately 1,200 weather stations**, with AMY files roughly matching TMY3 station locations. See *ResStock Technical Reference Guide: 2025 Release 1*, “Mapping Weather Files to ResStock Samples,” p. 52 ([report](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=52)).
